settings.text_primary: Tell your story here: who you are, where you started and why you make clothes.
settings.text_secondary: Describe your materials, where it is produced and what you care about.

settings.question: How do your sizes fit?
settings.answer: Most pieces are cut boxy with dropped shoulders. If you are between sizes or want a closer fit, size down. Every product page links the size guide.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within a few business days. Delivery times and rates are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange?
settings.answer: Yes, unworn with tags attached. Start a return from your account.

settings.question: Will sold-out items restock?
settings.answer: Some do, most do not. Sign up to the newsletter to hear first when a restock or new drop goes live.
